card.name: Product name before prescribing information
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or device name right after "Refer to" or "see the", where the next words will be "prescribing information" or "user manual".

modes.label: Drug name before prescribing information
modes.description: Final piece of a drug name in a cross-reference to its prescribing information or dosing instructions.
modes.example: Refer to the Pombilit<<i>> Prescribing Information for Pombiliti

modes.label: Device name before user manual
modes.description: Last part of a device or system name just before "User Manual" or "User's Guide".
modes.example: Refer to BF-RhodoLED or RhodoLED<< XL>> user manual for detailed lamp safety and operating

card.writes: It promotes words for documentation, such as documentation and docs, as the next word.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a product name when the text is about to point the reader to that product's manual or prescribing information.
